title: One Ship's sign-in to one service (ship-fleet signins --json entries, version 1)
description: Each entry of `ship-fleet signins [--offline] --json`, a list most urgent first: the rows the web UI's Sign-ins page shows, each with the command that fixes it. Account names and states only, never a credential. With --offline it reads each Ship's last fetched status and answers while the vault is locked. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

service.description: The status document's auth key: claude, gcloud, gcloud_adc, github, or another sign-in's.

provider.description: The service ship-fleet login SHIP SERVICE signs it in with (gcloud-adc for gcloud_adc).

group.description: action: needs you. underway: a sign-in is running. degraded: expiring, a failed check, not known, or not signed in while nothing needs it. healthy: signed in. off: the Ship does not use it.

state.description: A short word for people: ok, expiring, expired, wrong account, scopes differ, missing, error, unknown, off (and the web UI's waiting, failed, ...).

level.description: For an icon and a word as well as a colour; null for healthy, off and under way.

since.description: Since when it has been as it is (or when it expired).

account.description: The account it is signed in as, as the tool reports it.

rank.description: Urgency within the group, lowest first (the list is already in order).

flow.description: The web UI's sign-in, when one is open: always null here.

answers.description: The Ship answered (or, offline, last answered), so signing in or out can work.

expires_at.description: An expiring sign-in: when it goes.

note.description: A second line about the last attempt: always null here (the web UI's).

drops.description: scopes differ: the GitHub scopes signing in again would drop.

keep.description: scopes differ: the choice that keeps them instead (the fix sets it).

fix.description: The ship-fleet command that resolves it; empty when healthy.

timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
